title: 식당 계산대에서: 따로 낼게요
objective: You can ask to pay separately and ask if a way of paying is OK.
summary: Two friends ask to pay separately at a restaurant counter.
setting: At the counter of a small Korean restaurant after lunch.

task.title: Practice paying separately
task.line: Read the dialogue and word list again, then follow the instruction for each question.

words.exampleMeaning: Can I get the bill here, please?
Please ring up the coffee separately.
I don't have any cash right now.
Can I have the receipt, please?

words.meaning: Can I/we ~? (asking if something is possible)
No, thank you (politely saying no to an offer)
words.exampleMeaning: I don't need a bag, thanks.

dialogue.korean: 아니요, 따로 낼게요. 따로 계산할 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: No, we'll pay separately. Can we pay separately?
Yes, that's fine. What did you have?
I had the kimchi stew. I'll pay by card.

dialogue.korean: 저는 비빔밥이요. 현금으로 낼 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: I had the bibimbap. Can I pay in cash?
Of course. Would you like a receipt?

exercises: Mark and his friend each pay for their own food. Choose the right word: 우리는 (같이 / 따로) 낼게요.
Change the verb into a question with -을/ㄹ 수 있어요?: ① 카드로 (계산하다) ② 여기에서 (먹다) ③ 영수증을 (받다)
Read the dialogue. Write O (true) or X (false): ① 마크는 카드로 내요. ② 민지는 영수증을 받아요.
Fill in each blank with one word: 계산, 영수증, 현금. ① 카드가 없어요. ____으로 낼게요. ② 저기요, 여기 ____해 주세요.
answers: ① 카드로 계산할 수 있어요? ② 여기에서 먹을 수 있어요? ③ 영수증을 받을 수 있어요?
